title: Junta Airstrike and Artillery Hit Schools and IDP Camp Near Demawso, Karenni State
detail: Around 6:00pm on August 6, 2026, junta aircraft bombed a middle-school building in western Demawso (Demoso), Karenni State, just after school dismissal. Artillery shells also landed near an IDP camp several miles from active fighting, killing one displaced man in his 50s and wounding a woman in her 70s, according to the Interim Executive Council. At least 5 surrounding schools closed indefinitely as a result.

media.caption: Junta airstrike hits a middle school in western Demawso, Karenni State, forcing closures at 5 schools.

title: Min Aung Hlaing Makes First Official Thailand Visit, Meets PM Anutin Charnvirakul
detail: President Min Aung Hlaing arrived in Bangkok on August 6, 2026 for his first official visit to Thailand since the 2021 coup, meeting Thai PM Anutin Charnvirakul at Government House on August 6-7. The two signed a memorandum of understanding on labor cooperation and discussed cross-border security, energy cooperation, trade facilitation, and border stability, agreeing to raise bilateral trade from $7.4 billion to a $12 billion target and reopening the Second Thailand-Myanmar Friendship Bridge (Mae Sot-Myawaddy). Thailand pledged to work toward Myanmar's 'full reintegration with ASEAN,' though ASEAN special envoy Maria Theresa Lazaro said normalization remained 'still far off.' Sixteen Thai civil-society and migrant-worker groups protested outside the UN office in Bangkok, calling the visit premature legitimization of a regime accused of war crimes; a Thai opposition MP also protested the 'red carpet welcome.'

media.caption: Min Aung Hlaing visits Thailand for the first time since the 2021 coup, seeking international legitimacy.
